# Creative Audit

## Purpose
Assess the state of the Creative department in the whole system: how well design, video, writing, images, branding, and content creation hold together, and where they are weak.

## Scope
- Design and visual identity
- Video creation and editing
- Writing and copy quality
- Images and illustration
- Branding and voice
- Content creation and publishing

## What is in place
- [ ] Lead agents for design and content are named and active
- [ ] Skill that guides interface and visual design
- [ ] Skill that guides content creation and strategy
- [ ] Skill that guides copywriting
- [ ] Workflow that reviews creative work before it ships
- [ ] Record of brand assets, templates, and style decisions in one place

## Gaps
- [ ] Design work ships without review
- [ ] Writing reads as generic and unedited
- [ ] Brand assets live in scattered files with no single source
- [ ] Video and image work has no consistent style
- [ ] Published content is not checked against the brand voice

## Next steps
- Pick the highest priority gap and name its owner
- Add or fix the missing agent, skill, command, or workflow for that gap
- Run the new piece on a real design or content piece and check the result against evidence
- Record the decision and the outcome in the decision log
- Repeat for the next gap
- Share the finished audit and the changes with the people who need them, so the work reaches distribution
